record.original_question: For which non-unimodal Hilbert functions H that occur for graded Artinian algebras A can one find a pair (A, ell) with H(A) = H such that the Jordan type and Jordan degree type of A agree with the contiguous Jordan type and contiguous Jordan-degree type determined by H?

evidence.quote: Question 5.2. For which (non-unimodal) Hilbert functions H occurring for graded Artinian algebras A, can we find pairs (A, ℓ) with H(A) = H and the Jordan type and Jordan degree types of A agree with the contiguous Jordan or Jordan-degree type of H?
When the Hilbert function H of a graded Artin module is non-unimodal, we can define a contiguous-Jordan type Pc,ℓ(H), and a contiguous-Jordan degree type Pc,deg,ℓ(H): using the bar graph of H(M).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A=\bigoplus_{i=0}^{d}A_i$ be a graded Artinian algebra over a field $\mathsf{k}$ of characteristic zero, with Hilbert function $H(A)=(h_0,h_1,\dots,h_d)$ where $h_i=\dim_{\mathsf{k}}A_i$. For a linear form $\ell\in A_1$, the Jordan type $P_\ell(A)$ is the partition of $\dim_{\mathsf{k}}A$ giving the block sizes of the nilpotent multiplication map $m_\ell:A\to A$, and the Jordan degree type $\mathcal S_\ell(A)$ is the refinement recording, for each Jordan block, the initial degree of a generator in a compatible graded basis.

For a sequence $H=(h_0,\dots,h_d)$ that occurs as the Hilbert function of some graded Artinian algebra, view its bar graph (the diagram whose $i$-th column has $h_i$ boxes). The contiguous Jordan type $P_c(H)$ is the partition obtained by reading the maximal horizontal strips of contiguous boxes in this bar graph (so $P_c(H)$ is the conjugate of $H$ whenever $H$ is unimodal, and is a strictly different partition when $H$ is non-unimodal). The contiguous Jordan degree type $\mathcal S_c(H)$ refines $P_c(H)$ by recording the column index at which each maximal horizontal strip begins.

Determine all non-unimodal sequences $H$ that occur as the Hilbert function of some graded Artinian $\mathsf{k}$-algebra and for which there exists a pair $(A,\ell)$ with $H(A)=H$, $P_\ell(A)=P_c(H)$, and $\mathcal S_\ell(A)=\mathcal S_c(H)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open research question in the area of Jordan type and Lefschetz properties of graded Artinian algebras. Recent related works (2024–2025) on Jordan degree type for codimension-three Gorenstein algebras and on Perazzo algebras address partial cases (specific families or restricted Hilbert functions) but do not provide a general characterization of which non-unimodal Hilbert functions admit a pair realizing the contiguous Jordan and Jordan-degree type. No source found resolves the question in general.

status_evidence.title: Jordan degree type for codimension three Gorenstein algebras of almost constant Hilbert function
status_evidence.snippet: Possible Jordan types and Jordan degree types for codimension three Artinian Gorenstein algebras are not well understood.
status_evidence.claim: Active research on partial cases; no general characterization.

status_evidence.title: Jordan type of Full Perazzo algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Jordan type for specific families of Artinian algebras with non-unimodal Hilbert functions.
status_evidence.claim: Related partial results exist for specific algebra families.

status_evidence.title: Artinian algebras and Jordan type
status_evidence.snippet: Framework for Jordan type and Lefschetz properties of graded Artinian algebras.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational reference; does not settle the contiguous Jordan-type question.
